claims.claim: A mortgage agreement in principle is required as evidence for First Homes scheme qualification.
claims.quote: You will also need to provide: proof of address last 3 month's payslips last P60 (or signed off self-employed accounts) last 3 months' bank statements a mortgage lender decision in principle (DiP)
claims.note: Arun Council requires a lender decision in principle for its applications; the national page does not establish a scheme-wide document requirement.

claims.claim: Proof of income is required as evidence for First Homes scheme qualification.
claims.quote: You will also need to provide: proof of address last 3 month's payslips last P60 (or signed off self-employed accounts) last 3 months' bank statements
claims.note: Arun Council lists income documents for its applications; the national page states income limits but not a universal proof requirement.
